name: gupta-skills
description: Gupta Technologies plugins for engineering discipline, security, product direction, critique, and stack craft across Flutter, Rust, and Next.js.

plugins.name: core-eng
plugins.description: Always-on engineering discipline: requirement interrogation, spec writing, diff review, git hygiene, test strategy, and systematic debugging. Stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: secure-ship
plugins.description: Always-on security and release gating: feature threat models, secrets and env handling, dependency risk, and a pre-ship go/no-go checklist for Flutter, Rust and Next.js.

plugins.name: product-direction
plugins.description: Opt-in design-ready brand context and product-surface direction across stacks; implementation remains in existing stack plugins.

plugins.name: critique
plugins.description: Judgment-only review skills: UI, motion, accessibility, architecture, API surface, and interface copy. Reads and ranks findings; never edits.

plugins.name: animate
plugins.description: Motion craft and mechanics: what deserves animation, timing and easing, scroll motion, design engineering, and Flutter motion taste.

plugins.name: web-ui
plugins.description: Web interface execution on top of frontend-design: design systems and tokens, landing page craft, design engineering, UX copy, and front-end performance.

plugins.name: next-saas
plugins.description: Next.js T3 SaaS engineering: App Router architecture, tRPC and Prisma patterns, auth and Stripe billing, API design, and deploy and observability.

plugins.name: flutter
plugins.description: Flutter application engineering for Android, Windows and Linux: architecture, UI craft, animation mechanics, desktop platform work, and release.

plugins.name: rust-crate
plugins.description: Rust crate engineering with a public-crate bias: structure, API ergonomics, async services, FFI bridges to Flutter, crates.io publishing, and performance and unsafe review.
